title: Precept One - Non-Killing
speaker: Nomon Tim Burnett
summary: The talk emphasizes the importance of cultivating compassion and awareness in our daily lives by exploring the ten clear mind precepts. These precepts encourage us to consider how our actions can harm or kill not just living beings, but also people's spirits through judgment and separation. By embracing a more nuanced and compassionate approach, we can learn to nourish life rather than killing it, and deepen our connection with ourselves and others by recognizing and accepting our own patterns of suffering.
